verifications.claim: Artemis II is a manned mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA's Artemis II astronauts', 'first piloted moonshot'; R2: 'crewed lunar flyby mission'; R3: 'first crewed Artemis flight'; R4: 'first mission to carry humans'; R5: 'crew of four astronauts'; R6: 'four astronauts'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly describe Artemis II as crewed with named astronauts aboard.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is launched in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '6:36 PM / April 1, 2026 Artemis II lifts off'; R2: 'Launch date April 1, 2026'; R3: 'LaunchED April 1, 2026'; R5: 'launched... on April 1'; R6: 'took off Wednesday evening [April 1]'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm exact launch on April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed flight of NASA's Artemis program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since... Apollo'; R2: 'first crewed flight of the NASA-led Artemis program'; R3: 'first crewed Artemis flight'; R4: 'first to fly astronauts... Artemis program'; R5: 'first crewed mission of... Artemis program'; R6: 'first crewed mission to the moon in more than five decades'
verifications.reasoning: All sources state it is the first crewed Artemis mission after uncrewed Artemis I.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'four astronauts', '10-day mission', 'loop around [moon]'; R2: 'Crew size 4', '9 days, 1 hour... around the Moon'; R3: 'four astronauts', '9 Days, 1 Hour, 32 Minutes'; R4: 'four astronauts on a... 10-day mission'; R5: 'crew of four astronauts... 10-day mission around the Moon'; R6: 'four astronauts on a historic 10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: All confirm four astronauts, ~10-day duration (precisely 9+ days), lunar flyby trajectory.

verifications.claim: Crew members of Artemis II are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (all NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen'; R2: 'Reid Wiseman (NASA), Victor Glover (NASA), Christina Koch (NASA), Jeremy Hansen (CSA)'; identical in R3-R6
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew names and agencies match across all sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a lunar flyby.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'loop around it [moon]'; R2: 'Crewed lunar flyby'; R3: 'Crewed Lunar Flyby'; R4: 'looping journey around the moon'; R5: 'around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: All describe mission as lunar flyby, no landing or orbit.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to test life support systems, communications, and navigation.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'check out the Orion capsule, making sure... communications, navigation, propulsion and life support systems'; R2: 'validate the Orion spacecraft's systems'; R3: 'test Orion’s systems'; R4: 'test life-support, navigation and communications systems'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly list testing of specified systems.

verifications.claim: Crew of Artemis II travels aboard the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All sources: 'Orion capsule/spacecraft carrying the Artemis II crew/astronauts'
verifications.reasoning: Universally stated that crew flies in Orion.

verifications.claim: Orion spacecraft is launched by the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All: 'SLS rocket launches Orion for Artemis II'

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since... 53 years ago'; R2: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R6: 'first crewed mission to the moon in more than five decades'
verifications.reasoning: All affirm >50 years since Apollo 17 (1972-2026=54 years).

verifications.claim: Apollo 17 was the last crewed mission to the Moon before Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program'; R2: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; identical context in others
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly name Apollo 17 as last crewed lunar mission.
